title: Compulsory Service in the Armed Forces Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Compulsory Service in the Armed Forces Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

COMPULSORY SERVICE IN THE ARMED FORCES
COMPULSORY SERVICE
IN THE ARMED FORCES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LXIII OF
2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Compulsory Service the Armed Forces Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
6-12-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. (1) This Ordinance may be called the Compulsory Service in
the Armed Forces (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the 4th October,
1984.

Amendment of section 9-A, Ordinance XXXI of 1971

COMPULSORY SERVICE IN THE ARMED FORCES
COMPULSORY SERVICE
IN THE ARMED FORCES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LXIII OF
2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Compulsory Service the Armed Forces Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
6-12-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 9-A,
Ordinance XXXI of 1971.---In the Compulsory Service in the Armed Forces
Ordinance, 1971 (XXXI of 1971), in section 9-A, after the word
"Government" occurring for the second time, the commas and words
",or an organization controlled by the Federal Government or a Provincial
Government, or any statutory or local body" shall be inserted.
